items.summary: Never thought I’d lower my rating from 5. LIGHT, what are you thinking. Whales can’t enjoy this endgame update you produced because it renders most of their spent characters useless. You also chopped players’ progression speed. I’m a mid spender and I’m stuck on the FIRST TWO DIFFICULTIES OF DTIDE. No one is winning except for very casual players who drool at the sight of those 100 pulls that EXPIRE when the beloved gtulu drops 😭
